text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and your mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains, and try to avoid too much sugar and fast food. Second, exercise regularly — even a short walk every day makes a difference. Good sleep is also essential, so aim for seven to eight hours each night. Don't forget your mental health: talk to friends and family when you feel stressed. Finally, try to keep a healthy work-life balance by making time for hobbies and rest. Small daily habits can lead to a happier, healthier life.
